sentences.text: Anna snakker om familien. Hun snakker om mora og faren.
sentences.english: Anna talks about her family. She talks about her mother and her father.

sentences.text: Hvem er dette?
sentences.english: Who is this?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Dette er mora mi. Hun heter Ingrid.
sentences.english: This is my mother. Her name is Ingrid.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Og dette er faren min. Han heter Olav.
sentences.english: And this is my father. His name is Olav.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Bor mora di og faren din her i byen?
sentences.english: Do your mother and your father live here in town?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Nei, i Trondheim.
sentences.english: No, in Trondheim.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Hvem er han?
sentences.english: Who is he?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Det er Lars. Han er broren min.
sentences.english: That is Lars. He is my brother.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Lars er tretti år. Jeg er tretti år også.
sentences.english: Lars is thirty years old. I am thirty years old too.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Hvem er hun?
sentences.english: Who is she?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Hun er søstera mi. Hun heter Kari. Hun er tjue år.
sentences.english: She is my sister. Her name is Kari. She is twenty years old.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Jeg har en bror og ei søster.
sentences.english: I have a brother and a sister.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Jeg har en bror også. Han bor i USA.
sentences.english: I have a brother too. He lives in the USA.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Bor han i Bergen?
sentences.english: Does he live in Bergen?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Nei, han bor ikke i Bergen. Han er ikke her.
sentences.english: No, he does not live in Bergen. He is not here.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Familien min bor i USA.
sentences.english: My family lives in the USA.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Jeg liker familien din, Sam!
sentences.english: I like your family, Sam!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Jeg liker familien din også!
sentences.english: I like your family too!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Marta bor i byen. Hun er bestemora til Nils.
sentences.english: Marta lives in town. She is Nils's grandmother.

sentences.text: Marta er ikke trøtt i dag. Hun er glad.
sentences.english: Marta is not tired today. She is happy.

sentences.text: Nils bor hjemme. Huset er lite, men han er glad. Skolen er stor.
sentences.english: Nils lives at home. The house is small, but he is happy. The school is big.

sentences.text: Hei, Nils! Hvordan går det?
sentences.english: Hi, Nils! How are you?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Det går bra, takk.
sentences.english: I am fine, thank you.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Går du til skolen i dag?
sentences.english: Are you going to school today?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Ja, jeg går til skolen. Men jeg er trøtt.
sentences.english: Yes, I am going to school. But I am tired.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Har du brød og vann?
sentences.english: Do you have bread and water?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Ja, jeg har brød og vann. Jeg liker brød.
sentences.english: Yes, I have bread and water. I like bread.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Bra! Spis brødet, Nils.
sentences.english: Good! Eat the bread, Nils.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Gå til skolen! Ha det bra, Nils.
sentences.english: Go to school! Goodbye, Nils.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Ha det bra, Marta!
sentences.english: Goodbye, Marta!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Nils går til skolen. Lars er på skolen også.
sentences.english: Nils goes to school. Lars is at school too.

sentences.text: Lars er læreren til Nils. Læreren er glad i dag.
sentences.english: Lars is Nils's teacher. The teacher is happy today.

sentences.text: Hvordan er rommet ditt, Sam?
sentences.english: How is your room, Sam?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Det er lite, men jeg har et vindu.
sentences.english: It is small, but I have a window.
sentences.speaker: sam
